_comment: Gate A12: diyHue is the open, versioned reference implementation of the Hue bridge API v1 that hueemu emulates. Compared at 2022.8 (2026-11-07): pairing (POST /api with link button, error 101, generateclientkey), the short config (GET /api/config fields) and the light shape (type strings, state keys, uniqueid form, manufacturer) agree. Deliberate differences: no capabilities (design decision 6), no light config block, ct is reported for LTW001 (diyHue 2022.8 leaves it out), own swversion.
